verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a cloud application platform like Render, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency controls. The global CDN mention (render-docs-19) concerns static-asset caching, not where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
